svg.title: multiCSN — editable vector reconstruction
svg.desc: Reconstructed from the supplied 1254 by 1254 reference. Independent hexagon, RNA heatmap tiles, ATAC peaks and baselines, regulatory nodes and arrows, eight live text characters, and three network medallions. No raster image is embedded. The embedded WOFF is font data only; install the accompanying TTF for desktop editors that ignore SVG webfonts.
